To use Location Services, allow Instagram to access your location
How you can use Location Services
Turning on your device location lets you share your location and discover places near you like when adding a location to a post, reel or story.
How we’ll use this information
We’ll do things like show you personalized content, ads, and places nearby, and help keep your account secure.
How you can control this
You can change this anytime in your device settings. Even if Location Services is off, we use things like your IP address to estimate your general location.
